state.background: B3h is a bounded candidate-screen checkpoint after B3g reached and passed the 20/20 cadence gate and one consolidated E2E run. A fresh inventory-wide audit found no defensible next assertion slice to migrate safely at this point. Reviewed categories: (1) route/dataflow/chart-table/CSV contracts and quarterly production data depend on production route, integrated data, or download/parity behavior; (2) UI actions with existing unit/Browser coverage would duplicate an established owner; (3) mobile production layout, viewport/scroll geometry, and WebKit behavior remain route/browser-specific; (4) unresolved focus/contrast contracts lack adequate component-only evidence. Closest candidates P42-018/-019 were rejected: P42-018 outside-click duplicates existing unit coverage, while its scroll behavior remains route-level; P42-019 does not provide a safe independent slice under that boundary. Do not select an alternative solely to advance a counter. Mark prior 20-case gate passed and the next cadence freshly starting at 0/20. Preserve A=123/E=90/M=1, Phase5 investigations, and all existing B3g results.

plan.instructions: Select exactly one mutually exclusive criterion for this B3h candidate-screen plan checkpoint.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The documented screening conclusion and 0/20 reset are appropriately bounded and preserve the prior gate and migration constraints.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: The proposed candidate-screen conclusion conflicts with the migration requirements or prior accepted state.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: Evidence required to assess the candidate categories or rejected cases is absent.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The plan improperly claims implementation or test facts not supplied.
criteria.implementation_issue: A concrete source constraint invalidates the stated candidate-screen finding.
criteria.scope_violation: The plan changes counts, claims a migration, or advances cadence without evidence.
criteria.other: A material planning concern does not fit the listed criteria.
criteria.indeterminate: The supplied evidence cannot support a reliable judgment.
